body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>

Sage Infotech has presented its IP set-top box platforms with MS Windows CE operation system at CES 2006. Kalaheo IPV 400 & IPV 500 features advanced Digital IP Set-Top Box and video client platform while ''Hermes'' is a client/server solution for content delivery.
Since it can deliver content over satellite, terrestrial, and the internet, it could be useful for local content operator or outdoor advertisement.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliyah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
